_doc: Composition of the vitamin/mineral premix every feed carries, per kg of premix, as
supplied by the FASA team (FASA APP DATA.xlsx, sheet PREMIX, received 2026-10-29):
one default premix for every user, at 1, 1.5 or 2% of the feed.
Each entry is keyed by the ASNS spec code it supplies. The engine adds
amount x premix_rate to that nutrient (per kg of feed), so these specs are checked like
any other nutrient, premix included. `label` is the name on the FASA sheet; `unit` is the
sheet's unit per kg of premix and must equal the spec's ASNS unit without '/kg'
Not used: cobalt (200 mg) and BHT (1500 mg), for which ASNS sets no requirement.
Choline and inositol are not in this premix and stay in premix_mask.json.
